summary.headline: Watery Triplicity in the Signs
summary.text: Astrological predictions for Venus and the Moon in the watery triplicity, especially in Libra, Scorpio, Cancer, and Pisces, concerning rain, winds, markets, marriages, travelers, women, ships, messengers, musicians, and illness.
